intent: Fold high-frequency primitives onto grokzilla.shop /api/skills/* so they share payTo 0xDa1Eab46918882f8656a41cF9fCa80e2415369d1 and x402-list monitoring. Do not spawn extra Vercel hosts.

proposed_natives.description: Deterministic URL/filename slug from any string. Unicode fold, separator choice, max length.
proposed_natives.why_volume: Agents emit slugs on every content write. Cheapest possible habit-forming call.

proposed_natives.description: Mint 1-64 UUID v4 or v7 values in one call. Validate existing IDs.
proposed_natives.why_volume: Idempotency keys and correlation IDs fire every agent loop.

proposed_natives.description: SHA-256 / SHA-1 / MD5 hex+base64 of a string or canonical JSON. No file upload.
proposed_natives.why_volume: Content addressing and cache keys. Deterministic, cheap, cacheable.

proposed_natives.description: RFC 6901 get / exists / list paths against a JSON document.
proposed_natives.why_volume: Agents already pay for json-flatten; pointer is the read-side twin.
